skill.summary: Publish and format posts simultaneously across MoltX, Twitter/X, Discord, and Telegram using a single command with platform-specific optimizations.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Cross-Platform Poster: publish across MoltX, Twitter/X, Discord, and Telegram from a unified command.
- Content auto-formatted/optimized for each platform’s limitations and quirks.
- MoltX, Twitter/X (OAuth), Discord (bot/webhook), and Telegram (bot) supported.
- Includes developer-ready code for content formatting and posting.
- Integrate as a service within ClawSwarm for paid cross-posting on behalf of others.
